name: Baseline
idea: The textbook genetic algorithm with the settings that won Round 0's tuning search.

survival.how: the 2 shortest trips are kept unchanged

reproduction.how: each child's mother wins a contest of 7 random members

pairing.how: each child's father wins a separate contest of 7 random members

variation.how: every child: edge recombination of its parents, then one reversed stretch

resources.how: every child is measured once; nothing else is measured
